headline: Target Delivers Strongest Sales Growth in Five Years and Lifts Outlook
summary: Target reported its strongest quarterly sales gains in roughly five years during Q3, driven by price cuts and same-day delivery expansions. The company subsequently raised its full-year earnings and sales outlook.
why: Target is one of the largest retail chains in the United States, providing a key measure of consumer discretionary spending.

impacts.name: Target
impacts.why: Target posted strong revenue growth and raised its full-year earnings forecast.
